name: This Is Spinal Axe
label: Quest
description: This Is Spinal Axe: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have you seen the huge beasts of Thunder Ridge? I keep thinking the spines on their backs would be perfect for crafting the head of a mighty axe. Saru laughed when I told him... But what does he know!?
As part of your smithing lessons, you can help me out! Bring me some of those spines, along with grinding stones to sharpen them.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These spines are tougher than I expected, friend! Crafting with them may not be as easy as I thought... But I'll keep working on it!

sources.title: Forever's own quest text, captured in game
Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
